scripts.build: npm run build:html && npm run build:css && npm run build:critical && npm run copy:assets && npm run build:js
scripts.build:html: posthtml src/index.html -o dist/index.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/work-and-ethic.html -o dist/work-and-ethic.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/the-giants.html -o dist/the-giants.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/non-jobs.html -o dist/non-jobs.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/jobs.html -o dist/jobs.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/talk-to-us.html -o dist/talk-to-us.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/404.html -o dist/404.html -c posthtml.config.cjs
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist/css && postcss src/css/pages/index.pcss -o dist/css/index.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/work-and-ethic.pcss -o dist/css/work-and-ethic.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/the-giants.pcss -o dist/css/the-giants.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/non-jobs.pcss -o dist/css/non-jobs.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/jobs.pcss -o dist/css/jobs.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/talk-to-us.pcss -o dist/css/talk-to-us.css --env production && postcss src/css/pages/404.pcss -o dist/css/404.css --env production
scripts.dev: npm run copy:js && npm run build:html && concurrently -k -n html,css,assets,js,serve "npm run dev:html" "npm run dev:css" "npm run dev:assets" "npm run dev:js" "npm run dev:serve"
scripts.dev:html: onchange -i "src/**/*.html" "src/**/*.svg" -- sh -c 'posthtml src/index.html -o dist/index.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/work-and-ethic.html -o dist/work-and-ethic.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/the-giants.html -o dist/the-giants.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/non-jobs.html -o dist/non-jobs.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/jobs.html -o dist/jobs.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/talk-to-us.html -o dist/talk-to-us.html -c posthtml.config.cjs && posthtml src/404.html -o dist/404.html -c posthtml.config.cjs'
scripts.dev:css: sh -c 'mkdir -p dist/css && concurrently -k -n index,work,theGiants,nonJobs,jobs,talkToUs,page404 "postcss src/css/pages/index.pcss -o dist/css/index.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/work-and-ethic.pcss -o dist/css/work-and-ethic.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/the-giants.pcss -o dist/css/the-giants.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/non-jobs.pcss -o dist/css/non-jobs.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/jobs.pcss -o dist/css/jobs.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/talk-to-us.pcss -o dist/css/talk-to-us.css -w" "postcss src/css/pages/404.pcss -o dist/css/404.css -w"'
